purpose: Teach: アルク/ホース/ボディー/マリン/キッド/チャーリー/アドバンス/ブランチ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、英会話アルクの教材使ってたな
lines.en: Riku, you were using those Alc English learning materials, weren't you.
lines.style: Teasing lilt at the end. Light, almost playful attack. Casual certainty — she's caught him in something harmless. Brief pause before his name to grab his attention.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、庭のホース、つまり水撒きホースで水遊びしてたな、桜
lines.en: You were out in the yard playing with the garden hose, Sakura.
lines.style: Flat, dry counter-observation. No defensiveness — just returns the volley with equal weight. Slight edge on 'you' — matching her tone exactly. Unbothered.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、車のボディーカラー、青がいいって言ってたな
lines.en: Riku, I remember you saying blue was your favorite car color.
lines.style: Lighter than before — less caught, more remembering. Genuine curiosity underneath. Softer attack, like she's not trying to score points anymore.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、夏休みマリンスポーツやってたな、桜
lines.en: You were always doing water sports over summer break, weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost matter-of-fact. Not accusatory — just noting. Slight warmth creeping in. The tone of someone who paid attention when they weren't supposed to.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、キッド系のホップヒップ聴いてたな
lines.en: Riku, you were really into Kid's Hiphop back then.
lines.style: Quickening pace slightly. Teasing sharpens again — she's enjoying this. Knowing smirk in the voice. The certainty of someone calling out something they find endearing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、英語の教科書でチャーリー・ブラウン読んだろ、桜
lines.en: You read Charlie Brown in your English textbook, remember, Sakura.
lines.style: Turning it back on her with quiet precision. Slight uptick in tone on 'remember' — gentle call-out. Not mean. The rhythm of two people who know each other's weak spots.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ゲームのアドバンス機まだ持ってたな
lines.en: Riku, you were still keeping that Game Boy Advance back then.
lines.style: Slight laugh underneath the words. The fondness of remembering something outdated someone held onto. Warm wryness. Attack is softer — she's not trying to wound now.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、休日にブランチ写真投稿してたな、桜
lines.en: You were always posting pictures of brunch on your days off, Sakura.
lines.style: Closing volley — quiet, almost gentle wryness. Slight smile in the delivery. Not cutting. The last word of someone who's won not by force but by knowing exactly what matters. Trails slightly.
